summary: The bounded real-run d1-canary selector was live-exercised on one deliberately dispatched admin-watchdog run. Exactly one dispatched run was selected, its heartbeat write landed in D1 with detail.m11OpsHeartbeatCanary=true while the Supabase watchdog row stayed byte-for-byte at its baseline, and all authority/boundary vars were restored to resting supabase afterwards. Only the bounded d1-canary authority (one run) is proven; a full heartbeat-domain D1 write authority is NOT claimed and read authority remained Supabase throughout.

supabaseWatchdog.interpretation: the Supabase watchdog row stayed exactly at baseline during the canary, proving the d1-canary write went to D1 and not to Supabase

whatThisProves: the real Node/GitHub call path (run_id = GITHUB_RUN_ID) can be selected by the d1-canary authority via the explicit workflow_dispatch-pinned detail.m11OpsHeartbeatCanary marker
an OIDC-authenticated boundary POST /v1/ops/heartbeat can be routed to D1 for exactly the canary run
the D1 watchdog row updates to the exact GitHub run id with the canary marker while the Supabase watchdog row is untouched
all authority vars and the temporary OIDC allowed-refs binding were restored, and the resting boundary rejects unauthenticated access
whatThisDoesNotProve: a full heartbeat-domain D1 write authority (ordinary, non-canary heartbeats still resolve to Supabase)
a D1 read authority: reads remained Supabase throughout, and no live d1 read parity is claimed
M11 completion: admin_ops_events (M11.4), ingest and core/publication remain pending

nextGate.name: Move heartbeat writes fully to D1 while reads remain Supabase
nextGate.precondition: the bounded d1-canary real-run canary above is live-proven; the D1 row shape/marker parity is confirmed
sequence: coordinate both authority vars to full d1 for one deliberate window: set the boundary Worker WORLDCONS_OPS_HEARTBEAT_WRITE_AUTHORITY=d1 and the repo var WORLDCONS_OPS_HEARTBEAT_WRITE_AUTHORITY=d1 (no d1-canary marker, no canary dispatch input needed)
dispatch/observe one ordinary admin-watchdog run; confirm the ordinary heartbeat lands in D1 with the real GitHub run id and no marker, and confirm the Supabase watchdog row does not advance
keep WORLDCONS_OPS_HEARTBEAT_READ_AUTHORITY resolved to supabase on both the repo and the boundary Worker, so readers are unchanged during the write cutover
verify a D1 failure still fails closed (503, never silently downgraded to Supabase)
roll both write vars back to supabase and confirm the ordinary RPC path resumes
only after a stable soak, consider the combined full-d1 read/write cutover as a separate gate (M11.3R live-read parity)
